item.name: EXIT: The Game – The Secret Lab

play.comments:
Our first EXIT game and very much enjoyed. A couple of the puzzles were a little disappointing in things that they wanted to figure out on your own without help. And then some of the clues when you needed them were so super obvious, it felt like they were written for people who had temporarily lost their basic senses. But overall, waaaaaay better than the Unlock series of games. Too bad these are one-and-done. Can't even share them with a friend. But, they achieve a certain uniqueness for it. Nice for Jen and I as we were able to solve the clues for each other that neither of us good get. Turns out we're very complementary when it comes to problem solving!
We use, if I recall, three clue cards (two were utterly useless as they stated obvious things that anyone with common sense would have already figured out). Solved it just under 90 minutes, so I think we got 6 or 7 stars. Not bad.
